name: Yukimoto Taeka
source:
She is a senior to the protagonist's younger sister, Satsuki, and a student of the protagonist's junior, Kaoru.

She is quite keen to express her opinions, but has difficulty telling the person she likes (the protagonist) important things or what she wants to say.

There is a gap between her thoughts and actions, and she can sometimes show shrewdness and arrogance, but deep down she is a good person and honest.

She is cheerful, active, and expressive.

[Translated from the [url=http://tenshindo.amusecraft.com/pict/sm/smindex.html]the official site[/url]]
